1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Available in pressure stages of 330 bar and 420 bar, it reduces pressure fluctuations during peak demand and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console
A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.: Pressure vessel
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options
Safety valve and pressure gauge: Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.
The storage design: Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation
A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.
The size of the storage system depends on:: Compressor delivery rate (l/min)
Air consumption of the specific application: Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis)

V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume): Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar
We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. What
is the I26 series used for?
The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. Typical applications include industrial compressed air and nitrogen supply, process gas systems, research and development, test facilities and applications with permanent high-pressure demand where thermal stability and high operational reliability are required.
What
performance ranges does the I26 series cover?
The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 2,200 to 3,300 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. This makes the series suitable for medium to high-capacity industrial applications in continuous operation.

Connection for external air inlet
When filling breathing air cylinders, the quality of the compressed air depends on the quality of the ambient air being drawn in. Particularly when exhaust gases (CO) or ventilation from other equipment may enter the compressor room, pure fresh air must be drawn in from outside. For this purpose, a connection for an external air inlet is provided.
B-CONTROL III
The B-CONTROL III is the premium control system for complex applications. Its 7-inch touchscreen display provides a user-friendly visualization of all operating data. Features such as a data logger, USB interface, Remote HMI, and protocols including OPC UA, Modbus, and CAN bus are integrated. The control system supports up to four compressors in a network and can be expanded flexibly.
Particle filter
An integrated particle filter is optionally available in combination with the P 41, P 61, and P 81 purification systems, ensuring consistently high purity levels.
Intermediate pressure gauge
Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system.

B-CLOUD & B-APP
With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization.
B-LINK
Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system.
Oil level monitoring
When the minimum oil level mark is reached, a warning message appears in the control system. This option is particularly recommended for continuous operation and increases the operational safety of the compressor system by providing early information about critical fill levels.

HIGH-PRESSURE STORAGE SYSTEM
These high-performance storage systems sup-
port the short-term availability of large quan-
tities of air and gas and allow a fluctuating air
consumption.
At the same time, a carefully selected storage
module optimizes runtime of the compressor
and also serves as a pulsation damper.
The storage systems are available in pressure
stages of 330, 350 and 420 bar. They can be
­expanded as required by adding 50 or 80 l
storage cylinders.
The storage system should be dimensioned
to guarantee that the compressor operates
continuously for a minimum period of 15 to 30
minutes.

YOUR SYSTEM

FEATURES

High-pressure
storage cylinder bank
B-SELECT
The automatic selector unit B-SELECT enables air cylin-
ders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel
from a storage system (buffer) and via the compressor.
The storage cylinder connected to the filling panel takes
priority for filling, i.e. the storage system and the compres-
sor always start by filling the breathing air cylinders at the
filling panel.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):
Vk (l/min): Compressor delivery volume in liters per minute: V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume)
Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar: We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

175 cm × 60 cm × 135 cm: Details & Features
The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve
For sensitive composite cylinders, the B-SAFE 300 can be equipped with an electronically controlled proportional valve. It allows a defined, medium filling speed between 20 and 50 bar/min, thus preventing pressure surges and time-consuming repressurizing.: Scope of delivery
Scope of delivery B-SAFE 300 with filling hoses: Safety cell with explosion-proof, automatically locking doors
Footnotes: 6 to 10 filling connections available

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve

It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.

The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.

The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.

The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.

Wird die Luft unter diese Tempera­ tur abgekühlt, beginnt der Wasserdampf zu kondensieren und es bildet sich Tau (= flüssiges Wasser). Deshalb spricht man hier vom Taupunkt. Wird dieser bei einem höheren Druck als dem atmosphärischen Druck ge­ messen, dann spricht man vom Drucktaupunkt. Diese Unterscheidung ist wichtig, weil sich mit Änderung des Drucks und/oder der Temperatur auch der Taupunkt ändert. Zum besseren Verständnis: Ein abgeschlossenes Luftvolumen reduziert sich unter steigendem Druck. Wird es beispielsweise von 1 bar auf 10 bar kom­ primiert, dann nimmt das Volumen auf 1/10 ab. Das bedeutet, bei gleicher Temperatur kann komprimierte Luft weniger Was­ serdampf aufnehmen als im nichtkomprimierten Zustand. Im Umkehr­ schluss muss komprimierte Luft durch ein Filtersystem entsprechend stär­ ker entfeuchtet werden als Luft unter atmosphärischen Bedingungen, damit die Feuchte beispielsweise nicht in ein Rohrleitungssystem oder eine Tauch­ flasche gelangen kann. Sobald die Luft so trocken ist, dass die enthaltene Feuchte erst unter 0°C zu Eis gefriert, spricht man vom Frostpunkt und nicht mehr vom Taupunkt. Heinz Bauer

Details & Features
The MINI-VERTICUS series sets new standards in technology and ergonomics. Equipped with the latest B-CONTROL control system, the MINI-VERTICUS is quiet, efficient and particularly maintenance-friendly. The well thought-out arrangement of the operating elements guarantees intuitive operation from the front. B-CONTROL MICRO compressor control system
The B-CONTROL MICRO is a modern, user-friendly compressor control system with a color display that intelligently manages and reliably monitors all basic functions. Interaction between the user and the control system is intuitive and straightforward, with information displayed in clear text. Various languages are available. External signal transmitters can be connected at any time, and operation in a networked system or with an external display is also possible.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Available in pressure stages of 330 bar and 420 bar, it reduces pressure fluctuations during peak demand and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console
A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.: Pressure vessel
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options
Safety valve and pressure gauge: Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.
The storage design: Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation
A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.
The size of the storage system depends on:: Compressor delivery rate (l/min)
Air consumption of the specific application: Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis)

V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume): Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar
We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.: Downloads

Con el desgaste, los daños o las fluctuaciones de presión, las mangueras de alta presión importantes para la seguridad pueden resul­ tar peligrosas.Nuestro sistema de retención le proporciona una protección adicional. Con él se evitan eficazmente golpes incontrola­ dos de las mangueras de alta presión en caso de derrumbe. BAUER KOMPRESSOREN recomienda el equipamiento posterior de sus instalaciones. FUNCIONAMIENTO:

design engineers. And no wonder; for almost three-quar- ters of a century, BAUER the man has been inseparable from BAUER the com- pany. Heinz Bauer’s life with BAUER be­ gan shortly after the Second World War in 1946, when the newly founded com- pany began operations. After leaving school, he went straight into the company. In 1956 he played a leading role in developing the legendary UTILUS, the original diving compressor. Das Entstehen einer Gewährleistungspflicht hat eine fachge- rechte Ausführung des Einbaus der Geräte und weiteren Lie- fergegenstände von BAUER zur Voraussetzung. Die Gewähr- leistungspflicht erlischt, wenn die gelieferten Waren von frem- der Seite verändert, Teile fremder Herkunft eingebaut oder für den Betrieb, die Instandhaltung oder die Instandsetzung an- dere als Original-Ersatzteile, -Schmierstoffe und -Verbrauchs- materialien im Sinne von Ziffer XI 1. dieser AGB verwendet werden. Sie erlischt ebenso, wenn der Kunde Vorschriften zur Inbetriebnahme missachtet und dadurch ein Mangel hervorge- rufen wird.

Die Gewährleistungsfrist beträgt ein Jahr ab Gefahrübergang. Die Regelung über die Verjährung von Rückgriffsansprüchen des Unternehmers gegen den Lieferanten aus §§ 478, 479 BGB bleibt in allen Fällen unberührt.

VARIATION IN RATE OF CUSTOMS DUTY Wherever, the price includes landed cost (CIF cost in Rupees plus current rate of customs duty and clearing charges in Rupees) of imported components, any increase in selling price due to an upward revision in the rate of customs duty shall be to the Buyer's account.

VARIATION IN RATE OF EXCHANGE Quotation is based on the present rate of exchange between the Indian Rupee and the currency of the country from which the goods/parts/components are to be imported. Any loss suffered by BKI as a result of fluctuation in rate of exchange at the time of remittance will be to the account of the Buyer.

SPECIFICATIONS A) The information as regards specifications of Goods given in the Quotation or in any of BKI's publications, drawing, literature etc. is only intended to present a general idea of the Goods offered for sale. They are not binding on BKI in all minute details. The specifications are subject to modifications without notice. B) Performance parameters are subject to tolerances e.g. ± 5% for flow rate, power, pressure, rpm and ± 10% for net weight and dimensions. C) BKI also reserves the right to make changes in the design of components or material which in BKI's judgement are necessary or which are necessitated by the non-availability of raw materials/components etc.

Einmal live mitzuerleben, wie der eigene BAUER Kompressor vom Rohgussteil bis zur fertigen Anlage entsteht, war schon lange der Wunsch des fernsehbekann- ten Nordseetauchers Andi Peters. Schließlich verlässt er sich während sei- ner anspruchsvollen Expeditionen seit Anbeginn seiner Karriere vor 20 Jahren auf Atemluft des Marktführers bei Tauchsportverdichtern. Letzte Woche gab es endlich einen perfekten Anlass, die fast 1.000 Kilometer lange Anreise von Flensburg nach Geretsried südlich von München auf sich zu nehmen: Sein neuer tragbarer BAUER Expeditions- kompressor vom Typ OCEANUS, der ihm ab der Saison 2018 die notwendige Atemluft für seine Unternehmungen lie- fern wird, stand fertig geprüft und aus- lieferbereit im Werk. Und in der BAUER Akademie waren zwei Plätze in einem Kompressorwartungskurs für ihn und seinen Teamkollegen Thomas Reim re- serviert. Nach einem Tag Theorie und einem Tag Praxis am Kompressor unter Anleitung des erfahrenen Akademie- chefs Martin Stein fühlen sich die bei- den jetzt fit, alle notwendigen Wartungs- arbeiten am Kompressor selbst fach­ gerecht durchzuführen. Während der AUSGABE 1/2018 Im Rahmen eines packenden, 90-minütigen Vortrags über ihre Wracktauchexpeditionen nehmen Andi ­Peters und Thomas Reim die Zuschauer auf eine spannende Reise in die Tiefen der Nordsee mit. Stolz präsentieren Andi Peters (links) und ­Thomas Reim ihren neuen OCEANUS masTim. Der neue PE-VE Industrie besticht durch ein hervorragendes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.

the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. If the condition of your compressor system changes, B-CLOUD or B-APP will notify you immediately – by email or via push notification straight to your smartphone. B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. Intermediate pressure gauge Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system. Separate intake buffer and condensate vessel In this closed system, the gas released during automatic condensate drainage is captured within the containers and fed directly back into the compression process. The system can also operate without a customer-supplied gas balloon. Its design is based on the combined container concept but consists of two separate vessels. The delivery scope also includes a suction solenoid valve and a compensation line for returning the collected gas to the intake side of the compressor. B-SAFE 300
TAKING FILLING SAFETY
TO A NEW LEVEL
B-SAFE 300 – Uncompromising safety for
persons and compressor rooms when filling
pressure cylinders.
The stationary safety filling station controls the
filling speed of the breathing air cylinders for
diving or respiratory applications1. The cylinders
are placed in the B-SAFE 300 and attached
to the fill valves. The integrated filling control
system then begins the filling process, automati-
cally locking the doors to eliminate the chance
of operating errors.
If an incident occurs during filling – such as
explosion of a pressurised cylinder – the welded
steel safety chamber contains the metal frag-
ments and allows the pressure wave to dissipate
through grilles on both sides and in the top
cover.
The B-SAFE thus replaces costly protective
measures for filling facilities and provides
­operators with a high level of (legal) security.
FEATURES
› Explosion-proof filling chamber
› 6 to 10 cylinders can be filled at the same
time
› Operating pressure up to 410 bar
› Optional: simultaneous filling of 225/330 bar

AIR AND GAS PURIFICATION
› B-AEROGUARD-OX CO2 Absorber
The B-AERO-GUARD-OX CO2 Absorber is highly recommended as
an extra for the nitrox membrane system, as through the separa-
tion of nitrogen in the membrane significantly increases not only
oxygen, but also the CO2 content. AERO-GUARD-OX reduces the
CO2 content of the oxygenated air – a function that is even more
vital in nitrox production than in breathing air compression.
Optionally, a control lever can be used in conjunction with B-
DETECTION PLUS to precisely adjust the CO₂ reduction – thereby
extending the filter’s service life.
FILLING AND SAFETY
› B-SAFE Nitrox Safety Filling System
B-SAFE-OX safety filling module increases the protection of persons and the environment during the filling
process. The rugged steel safety module protects the environment and persons from severed filling hose
connections and cylinder explosions during filling. The doors are automatically locked during filling.

B-SELECT
Automatic selector unit

For simultaneous filling of pressure cylinders with air from
storage system and compressor
Inlet pressure up to 420 bar
Flow rate up to 850 bar

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system
and the breathing air cylinder are nearly the same.

HOW IT WORKS
Filling of the breathing air cylinder connected to the filling panel takes priority. This means that the storage system
and the compressor always fill the cylinder connected to the filling panel first. Once the cylinders are completely
filled, the automatic selector unit independently switches over to filling the storage system.

When the maximum filling pressure of the storage system is reached, the compressor shuts down fully
automatically. As soon as the next empty breathing air cylinder is connected to the filling panel, the storage system
again fills the breathing air cylinder first. If the preset restart pressure in the storage system is undershot, the
compressor switches on.

The compressor then fills the breathing air cylinder up to the value preset on the backpressure regulator / pressure

What
performance ranges does the I52 series cover?
The I52 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 4,800 to 6,600 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. The systems are water-cooled, multi-stage and designed for continuous operation. The bionically shaped, pressure-resistant and gas-tight crankcase reduces leakage and mechanical stress and ensures high operational reliability and long service life. OPTIMUM QUALITY

HIGH-QUALITY MATERIALS
Quality is crucial when it comes to the performance and safety of a product. For this reason, all
BAUER filter cartridges are manufactured using materials including the highest-quality plastic
without any adhesives or solvents.
LONG SERVICE LIFE
Thanks to their consistently high production quality and shortest possible content processing
times, our filter cartridges have extended and clearly defined service lives on which you can rely!
Additional inspections are also carried out regularly at our testing centre. In line with the BAUER
ISO 9001 quality management system, every single stage in the production of the cartridges has
been certified. BAUER KOMPRESSOREN recommends that breathing air cartridges are changed
at least once a year or every three months if the unit has been shut down. Please also comply
with any shorter replacement intervals that may be in force locally.
SHORT PROCESSING TIME FOR BRANDED DESICCANTS
As the opening time for the desiccant container has a significant influence on the running time
of the cartridge, we make sure that we keep it to a minimum.

What
is the I26 series used for?
The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. Typical applications include industrial compressed air and nitrogen supply, process gas systems, research and development, test facilities and applications with permanent high-pressure demand where thermal stability and high operational reliability are required.
What
performance ranges does the I26 series cover?
The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 2,200 to 3,300 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. This makes the series suitable for medium to high-capacity industrial applications in continuous operation.

What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. It is used wherever helium needs to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures or reprocessed within recovery systems, for example in industrial processes, research facilities, test benches and gas recovery plants. What performance ranges does the G22 series cover for helium? Depending on the configuration, the high-pressure versions of the G22 series achieve final pressures of up to 350 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 620 to 1,500 litres per minute, depending on the model. 1 Underwater photographer Thomas Friedrich and his partner, Patricia Guar- diola Rico, have a dream that is probab- ly shared by many other divers – with the difference that they are making theirs come true. The couple is embar- king on a motorhome tour and exploring the best underwater diving spots along the way in the company of well-known locals. They’ll meet free diver Phil Sima to visit the Verzasca granite labyrinth and join shark expert Isaias Cruz in Bil- bao to encounter Atlantic blue and mako sharks. Further destinations along their route will be the caves and caverns at Alicante, the colourful gorgonian forests off the Costa Brava, and Second World War submarine wrecks at Marseilles. Their journey will be a celebration of freedom and independence. Many of the dives will be in remote areas. Here they naturally need an onboard supply of pure breathing air which is safe, relia- ble and – most important of all – inde- pendent of a mains power source. The solution is a petrol-driven mobile BAUER compressor. B-CLOUD & B-APP With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. B-SECURUS filter monitoring The B-SECURUS system monitors the saturation of the filter cartridge(s) by measuring the moisture level in the molecular sieve and provides a timely indication when a cartridge replacement is required – either on the display or via the control unit. Details & Features
The automatic selector unit enables simultaneous filling of breathing air cylinders via both a storage system and the compressor. Priority is given to the cylinders connected to the filling panel. Only once these are fully filled, the system begins replenishing the storage unit from the compressor. When the maximum storage pressure is reached, the compressor shuts off automatically. A new filling cycle begins as soon as another empty cylinder is connected.
The automatic selector unit performs three key functions:
Pre-filling the breathing air cylinders from the storage system by pressure equalization.
Filling the connected cylinder directly via the compressor until the final filling pressure is reached.
Replenishing the storage system until its maximum pressure is reached.
Options
Pressure regulator
Instead of the standard pressure retention valve, a precise pressure regulator can be selected. It allows stable and exact adjustment of the overflow pressure – ideal for time-critical filling processes with storage systems. Temperature and environmental fluctuations have little effect on its regulation, making it the preferred option.

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system

Details & Features
The automatic selector unit enables simultaneous filling of breathing air cylinders via both a storage system and the compressor. Priority is given to the cylinders connected to the filling panel. Only once these are fully filled, the system begins replenishing the storage unit from the compressor. When the maximum storage pressure is reached, the compressor shuts off automatically. A new filling cycle begins as soon as another empty cylinder is connected.
The automatic selector unit performs three key functions:
Pre-filling the breathing air cylinders from the storage system by pressure equalization.
Filling the connected cylinder directly via the compressor until the final filling pressure is reached.
Replenishing the storage system until its maximum pressure is reached.

Pressure regulator
Instead of the standard pressure retention valve, a precise pressure regulator can be selected. 175 cm × 60 cm × 135 cm: Details & Features
The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.

Die Reduzierung des Druckverlusts führt je nach Anlagentyp im Dauerlauf zu einem entsprechenden Liefermengengewinn sowie Energieeinsparung. Herzstück der neuen B-DRAIN ist das Kondensatven- til, das als Druckminderer wirkt: Der Betriebsdruck im Kondensatabscheider reduziert sich von bis zu 550 bar auf 2 bis 9 bar Steuerdruck. Beim Start des Kompressors (Anlage drucklos) ist das Kondensatventil offen. Das Magnetventil (1) wird geschlossen. Mit dem Druckaufbau des Kompres- sors baut sich auch der Steuerdruck unterhalb des Kolbens (2) auf. Dadurch wird der Kolben aufgrund der Flächenverhältnisse nach oben geschoben und damit das Kondensatventil geschlossen. Zum Kondensatablass wird das Magnetventil geöffnet. Dadurch bricht der Steuerdruck ein und der Kolben wird durch den Betriebsdruck an der Fläche (3) sowie durch die Kraft der Feder (4) nach unten gedrückt. Das Kondensat fließt nun über den Kolben und durch das Magnet­ventil aus dem Kondensatventil. Im Mag- netventil ist eine Drossel (5), die einen erneuten Anstieg des Steu- erdrucks bewirkt. Dieser Steuerdruck schließt den Kolben so weit, bis sich ein Kräftegleichgewicht ergibt. Der ­Abströmdruck des Kondensats bzw. der Druckluft ist damit vom Betriebsdruck weitgehend entkop- pelt. Dies ist der wesentliche Unterschied zu den Vorgänger-Kondensat-­Ablassautomatiken, bei dem das Kondensat bzw. die Druckluft mit dem jeweiligen Stufendruck (16 bis 550 bar) in einen Kondensattren- ner (Winnerltopf, Wilkerson-Abscheider) abströmt.

The BAUER Group does not compromise on a safe and healthy working environment for all employees and is committed to offering
safe and healthy workplaces in accordance with national legislation.
BAUER consistently complies with applicable environmental, safety and health (ESH) regulations as well as customer, community
and other requirements. The BAUER Group furthermore commits to continual improvement of its operations, progressively reducing

operations worldwide and on a regular basis.

promotes the physical and psychological wellbeing of its employees through health management initiatives.

What
performance range does the VERTICUS cover for helium?
The VERTICUS is an air-cooled high-pressure compressor for industrial applications and is specifically designed for the compression of helium and other noble gases.This BAUER G series offers delivery rates from 240 to 420 l/min and operating pressures of up to 350 bar, depending on the model and process gas.
How is the VERTICUS controlled and monitored?
The compressor is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, safe monitoring of operating parameters, and connectivity to the B-CLOUD and B-APP.
What
are the benefits of B-CLOUD?
B-CLOUD enables centralized digital monitoring of the compressor. Operators have continuous access to operating data, can monitor system status, and plan maintenance more efficiently.
Which
gases is the VERTICUS suitable for?
The G series is designed for the compression of helium as well as other noble gases. The configuration is optimized for high gas tightness and efficient handling of these gases.

itoring
The intake filter is equipped with a vacuum monitoring system, which is continuously monitored by the B-CONTROL compressor control unit.
B-CLOUD & B-APP
With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. If the condition of your compressor system changes, B-CLOUD or B-APP will notify you immediately – by email or via push notification straight to your smartphone.
B-LINK
Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system.
Intermediate pressure gauge
Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system.
Pre-lubrication pump
After extended downtimes, the bearings are automatically pre-lubricated to ensure safe start-up. This process is managed by the B-CONTROL control system.

HIGH-QUALITY MATERIALS
Quality is crucial when it comes to the performance and safety of a product. For this reason, all
BAUER filter cartridges are manufactured using materials including the highest-quality plastic
without any adhesives or solvents.

Thanks to their consistently high production quality and shortest possible content processing
times, our filter cartridges have extended and clearly defined service lives on which you can rely!
Additional inspections are also carried out regularly at our testing centre. In line with the BAUER
ISO 9001 quality management system, every single stage in the production of the cartridges has
been certified. BAUER KOMPRESSOREN recommends that breathing air cartridges are changed
at least once a year or every three months if the unit has been shut down. Please also comply
with any shorter replacement intervals that may be in force locally.

As the opening time for the desiccant container has a significant influence on the running time
of the cartridge, we make sure that we keep it to a minimum.

G60 V – THE NEW HELIUM RECOVERY SOLUTION
Helium has become a scarce commodity in recent years. Given this,
recovery of gaseous helium for return to the process cycle is
increasingly recognized as the most cost-effective and technically
feasible option, even for users with low or lowest helium needs. The
new, compact G60 V adds an easy-install turnkey helium recovery
system to BAUER’s product portfolio. It is ideal for hospitals and
clinics, laboratories and other medical institutions. The helium is
captured in the integrated collection balloon and compressed to
pressures of up to 200 bar by the compressor. Impurities in the
medium are removed by the filter system. The compressed gas is
then stored, usually in portable storage cylinders.

Intake device and intake buffer vessel
The intake device supplies air or gas to the compressor at a monitored intake pressure. If predefined pressure limits are exceeded or not met, the system automatically shuts down for protection. To minimize pulsations in the intake area, the use of an intake buffer tank is recommended.
Condensate collection system 60 l
The large condensate collection system centrally collects the condensate generated during compression. An integrated float switch reliably monitors the fill level. The silencer and filter unit reduce noise and prevent unpleasant odors in the working environment.

G60 V – THE NEW HELIUM RECOVERY SOLUTION
Helium has become a scarce commodity in recent years. Given this,
recovery of gaseous helium for return to the process cycle is
increasingly recognized as the most cost-effective and technically
feasible option, even for users with low or lowest helium needs. The
new, compact G60 V adds an easy-install turnkey helium recovery
system to BAUER’s product portfolio. It is ideal for hospitals and
clinics, laboratories and other medical institutions. The helium is
captured in the integrated collection balloon and compressed to
pressures of up to 200 bar by the compressor. Impurities in the
medium are removed by the filter system. The compressed gas is
then stored, usually in portable storage cylinders.

Intake device and intake buffer vessel
The intake device supplies air or gas to the compressor at a monitored intake pressure. If predefined pressure limits are exceeded or not met, the system automatically shuts down for protection. To minimize pulsations in the intake area, the use of an intake buffer tank is recommended.
Condensate collection system 60 l
The large condensate collection system centrally collects the condensate generated during compression. An integrated float switch reliably monitors the fill level. The silencer and filter unit reduce noise and prevent unpleasant odors in the working environment.
